Mateo / team — taking point on the annex and evaluation artifacts. Summary of what we'll provide and recommended language: 

1) Classification: Based on the use case you described (triage affecting appointment prioritization and potential impact on patient access), we recommend classifying as high-risk under Annex III (Health-related decision support). Rationale: contributes to decisions that could materially affect health service delivery. We'll state this explicitly and include mitigations that reduce operational risk.

2) Controls mapping (Article 10/11):
- Risk management system: documented model risk lifecycle, pre-deployment gating, and post-deployment monitoring.
- Data governance: data minimization, provenance tracking, and pseudonymization steps.
- Technical robustness: adversarial testing, input sanitization, confidence calibration and fallback model.
- Transparency & information to users: clear UI disclaimers and logs for human review.
- Human oversight: documented human-in-the-loop policies and escalation routes.

I've started a spreadsheet mapping each Article requirement to Redwood controls (eu-act-mapping.xlsx).

3) Evaluation & regression approach (short):
- Initial evaluation: full-scope evaluation with stratified holdout and edge-case probes; deliverable = Evaluation Report v1 (includes metrics, dataset census, known failure modes).
- Ongoing sampling: quarterly stratified sampling plus triggered sampling after any model update affecting >1% token distribution or after deployment incidents. Example sampling cadence in eval-sampling-plan.md.
- Regression checks: run automated unit/regression tests (synthetic & real prompts), diff the metrics and flag regressions (>2% degradation on critical metrics triggers rollback). We will include a small anonymized regression diff CSV as an example.

4) Evidence package we can deliver: evaluation report PDF (redacted), test harness logs (anonymized), model provenance manifest (version, quantization), and audit checklist. I'll prepare an example package for Suncrest.

5) Data residency: we support EU-only deployments. Customer data, logs, and audit trails can be scoped to EU regions. We will include recommended config snippets for the deployment annex.

6) Certifications: SOC 2 Type II attestation available (SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf). Third-party pentest summary is available under NDA; we can provide an executive summary.

I'll attach the mapping spreadsheet and the sampling plan to this thread. Planning to produce the final annex PDF + sample artifacts by 2027-06-15 (EOD).

Neha Kapoor
Senior Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference

Hi Ellen,

Thanks for the clear ask — please find our consolidated response and artifacts attached. High level answers below and next steps at the bottom. Full annex + evidence artifacts are attached as: Redwood_EU-AI-Act_Annex_Suncrest.pdf and evaluation-schedule.csv.

Summary answers:
1) Classification: Redwood recommends Suncrest treat the integration as a high-risk AI system under EU AI Act Annex III (healthcare-adjacent decision support). Rationale and recommended mitigations are in section 2 of the annex.

2) Controls & mapping: We map Redwood controls to the relevant Article 10/11 obligations (risk management, transparency, human oversight, robustness). See annex pages 5-9 and the attached eu-act-mapping.xlsx for row-level mappings.

3) Evaluation & regression approach:
- Initial evaluation: full-scope evaluation delivered as a PDF report (we've included an anonymized sample evaluation in the annex).
- Ongoing sampling: default quarterly sampling with a 1,000-case stratified sample; triggered sampling after model updates or incidents (detailed cadence in evaluation-schedule.csv).
- Regression gate: automated regression tests with metric diff thresholds; we provide a sample regression diff and a template for gating (included).

4) Evidence artifacts delivered for audits: evaluation report, model provenance manifest, anonymized test logs, and an evidence checklist. We can also provide a redacted pentest summary under NDA.

5) Data residency & deployment: We support EU-only control plane and data plane deployment. Logs and audit trails can be restricted to customer-managed EU regions. We include config snippets and an ops runbook in the annex.

6) Certifications: SOC 2 Type II (report attached) and ISO-standards adherence summary.

Next steps / call proposal:
- If helpful, let's do a 30-minute walkthrough to go through the annex and agree on any additions. I propose Thu 2027-06-17 at 10:00 CET — does that work?
- I'll upload the artifacts to a shared Drive folder and attach a DocuSign link for the NDA / data processing addendum if you want the pentest summary. HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7843/DEAL-2027-1189
